name: Model Genome Korea
description: DNA lineage test of Korean LLM & VLM foundation models

paragraphs: Model Genome Korea is a free, interactive tool that reveals the architectural lineage ("DNA") of every major Korean sovereign AI foundation model. It genotypes each Korean large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) — measured directly from public config.json files and model weights on Hugging Face — to show, objectively, which Korean AI models are built from scratch and which are derived from foreign open-weight bases like Qwen, Llama, or DeepSeek.

The tool covers foundation models from 9 Korean organizations that released self-developed foundation models on Hugging Face: LG AI Research (EXAONE), SKT (A.X), Upstage (SOLAR), NCSOFT (VARCO), NAVER (HyperCLOVA X), Kakao (Kanana), KT (Mi:dm), Motif Technologies (Motif), and VIDRAFT (AETHER) — spanning large enterprises, telcos, mid-size firms, and startups.

Model Genome Korea is an architecture-provenance explorer for Korean sovereign AI. Like a genetic paternity test for neural networks, it fingerprints each model's architecture and weights and reports a genotype — a single, at-a-glance label describing how original (or derived) the model is. Every value is measured from public artifacts, so the results are reproducible and vendor-neutral. This is a transparency tool, not an accusation: building on open-weight foundations (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral) is a standard and legitimate engineering practice across the industry.
